episode.title: Podcast Naturalness Quick Check
episode.summary: A short two-host demo about what makes podcast dialogue feel natural: stable voices, intentional pauses, and lively delivery.
episode.art_prompt: Editorial illustration of two podcast hosts at a simple studio desk with microphones, warm desk lamp, clean modern composition, no text.
episode.scene: Two hosts recording in a quiet professional studio.
episode.director_notes: Natural conversation; vary pace; avoid announcer delivery.

turns.speaker: HOST
turns.text: [excited] Welcome to our tiny quality check. Today we are testing whether podcast dialogue can feel natural.

turns.speaker: GUEST
turns.text: Thanks, Maya. [laughs] Naturalness is mostly about rhythm, not fancy words.

turns.speaker: HOST
turns.text: Exactly. Stable voices, clear turns, and pauses that sound intentional.

turns.speaker: GUEST
turns.text: Yes. Keep the delivery conversational and clean.

turns.speaker: HOST
turns.text: [laughs] If the join between us feels smooth, we are in good shape.

turns.speaker: GUEST
turns.text: Agreed. A short breath between speakers beats a hard click every time.

turns.speaker: HOST
turns.text: So if this short demo sounds continuous, the stitch is good enough for longer episodes.

turns.speaker: GUEST
turns.text: Perfect. Keep it simple, keep it human, and we are done.
